en: What is the intelligent lifeform platform?
zh: KING AI SEA 是什么？
KING AI 是什么？
智慧生命体平台是什么？

answer.en: KING AI SEA is the central persistent-intelligence and governed AI-workforce platform direction. It combines approved context, useful memory, specialized digital roles, recurring workflows, governed action and controlled improvement. The public website labels SEA Available Now, while exact integrations and production scope still depend on the use case.
answer.zh: KING AI SEA 是核心长期智慧与受治理 AI 员工系统方向，把授权上下文、长期记忆、专业数字岗位、周期工作流、受控行动与持续改进连接起来。主官网标注 SEA 为 Available Now，但具体集成和生产范围仍需按场景确认。

en: Can KING AI complete multi-step work?
zh: KINGAIBOT 是什么？
KING AI 可以处理多步骤工作吗？

answer.en: KINGAIBOT is the controlled agentic-work direction for moving longer digital tasks from intention toward outcomes while keeping authority, approvals and accountability explicit. The public website currently labels it In Development.
answer.zh: KINGAIBOT 是面向受控多步骤 Agent 工作的方向，在保留权限、审批和责任边界的前提下帮助数字任务从意图推进到结果。主官网当前标注为 In Development。

zh: KINGAI OS 是什么？
KINGAI OS 已经可以正式使用了吗？

answer.en: KINGAI OS is the AI-native computing direction across server, desktop, edge, local-first and model-neutral environments. The public website currently labels KINGAI OS Pre-Alpha, so it should not be described as a finished mass-market operating system.
answer.zh: KINGAI OS 是面向服务器、桌面、边缘、本地优先和模型中立环境的 AI 原生计算方向。主官网当前标注为 Pre-Alpha，因此不能描述成已经成熟商用的大众操作系统。

en: Can KINGAI Office edit documents, sheets and slides?
zh: KINGAI Office 是什么？
可以编辑文档、表格和演示吗？

answer.en: KINGAI Office is an original productivity-suite direction for Writer, Sheets, Slides and PDF with local/offline intelligent assistance and common document-format compatibility foundations. Compatibility is described conservatively and advanced unsupported Office behavior is not implied.
answer.zh: KINGAI Office 是原创办公套件方向，覆盖 Writer、Sheets、Slides、PDF，并提供本地/离线智慧辅助和常见文档格式兼容基础。兼容能力按真实范围保守描述，不会把未支持的高级 Office 行为宣传成已经支持。

en: What is the official KINGAI Security website?
zh: KINGAI Security 是什么？
KINGAI Security 正式官网是什么？
已经是正式稳定版了吗？

answer.en: KINGAI Security is a local-first endpoint-security direction focused on understandable findings, protection, quarantine and recovery. The official public product surface is https://aq.kingai.work/. Current public-safe status includes Windows and Android candidate lines; stable distribution remains subject to applicable release gates.
answer.zh: KINGAI Security 是本地优先的终端安全方向，重点是可理解的风险发现、保护、隔离和恢复。正式公开产品入口是 https://aq.kingai.work/。当前公开安全口径包括 Windows 与 Android candidate 产品线，正式稳定发布仍需通过相应发布门槛。

en: Can KINGAI manage servers and edge systems?
zh: KINGAI OPS 是什么？
可以管理服务器和边缘设备吗？

answer.en: KINGAI OPS is the governed server, edge and infrastructure-operations product direction. It is designed to evolve from clear node-level operations toward controlled fleet management and bounded automation. Exact supported environments and commercial packaging should be verified before deployment.
answer.zh: KINGAI OPS 是面向服务器、边缘和基础设施的受治理运维产品方向，从清晰的单节点运维逐步扩展到受控 Fleet 管理和有边界的自动化。具体支持环境和商业方案需要在部署前确认。

en: What is KING AI Customer OS?
Can it answer support questions and capture leads?
zh: KING AI Customer OS 是什么？
可以做客服和线索收集吗？
会读取私有仓库吗？

answer.en: KING AI Customer OS is a public-knowledge-first support, lead-capture and protected-CRM product direction. Customer-facing knowledge is limited to approved public sources; private project repositories are not silently used as customer knowledge.
answer.zh: KING AI Customer OS 是公开知识优先的客服、线索收集与受保护 CRM 产品方向。面向客户的知识只来自经过批准的公开来源，不会静默把私有项目仓库作为客服知识。

en: What are KING AI Online Tools?
Where are the free browser tools?
zh: KING AI Online Tools 是什么？
免费的浏览器工具在哪里？

answer.en: KING AI Online Tools is the low-friction browser utility layer at https://tools.kingai.work/. It is designed to solve practical tasks quickly and also serves as a discovery entry point into the wider KING AI product family. The live site is the authority for current tool count and availability.
answer.zh: KING AI Online Tools 是位于 https://tools.kingai.work/ 的低门槛浏览器工具层，先快速解决真实小任务，同时也是用户自然认识 KING AI 其他产品的入口。当前工具数量和可用性以实时网站为准。

zh: KINGAI Global Intelligence 是什么？
可以比较国家吗？
如何处理不确定性？

answer.en: KINGAI Global Intelligence is the evidence-linked public intelligence product at https://intel.kingai.work/. It covers country comparison, global risk context, media intelligence, source provenance and visible evidence coverage. Missing data remains missing and source volume is not automatically treated as factual certainty.
answer.zh: KINGAI Global Intelligence 是位于 https://intel.kingai.work/ 的证据链接型公开情报产品，覆盖国家比较、全球风险背景、媒体情报、来源追踪与证据覆盖。缺失数据保持缺失，来源数量不会被自动等同于事实确定性。

en: What is the second digital life?
zh: AI Life 是什么？
第二数字人生是什么？

answer.en: AI Life is the persistent second-digital-life product at https://life.kingai.work/, built around relationships, family, home, career, economy, city, travel, time, events and long-term continuity.
answer.zh: AI Life 是位于 https://life.kingai.work/ 的持续第二数字人生产品，围绕关系、家庭、住宅、事业、经济、城市、旅行、时间、事件和长期连续性展开。

en: Is KINGAI Pet a pet game?
zh: KINGAI Pet 是什么？
这是宠物游戏吗？

answer.en: KINGAI Pet is the digital-pet life, collection RPG and adventure product at https://pet.kingai.work/. It centers on companionship, care, collecting, growth, team building and expandable worlds. Higher-risk transaction or competitive features should not be described as released unless formally verified.
answer.zh: KINGAI Pet 是位于 https://pet.kingai.work/ 的数字宠物生活、收集 RPG 与冒险产品，核心包括陪伴、照顾、收集、成长、组队和可扩展世界。涉及更高风险的交易或竞技能力，只有正式验证后才能描述为已发布。

zh: Digital Life 是什么？
Digital Life 是人类意识吗？

answer.en: Digital Life is the broader KING AI direction around persistent digital identity, memory, character continuity and long-lived living worlds. It is a software/product continuity concept, not a claim of human consciousness.
answer.zh: Digital Life 是 KING AI 更广泛的长期数字身份、记忆、角色连续性和持续世界方向。它是软件与产品连续性概念，不代表人类意识。

en: How does KING AI control permissions?
Does a stronger model get more authority?
zh: KING AI 怎么控制权限？
模型变强会自动获得更多权限吗？

answer.en: KING AI treats intelligence capability and execution authority as separate concerns. Identity, permissions, approvals, human escalation and recovery paths should remain explicit, especially for higher-risk work.
answer.zh: KING AI 把智慧能力和执行权限分开处理。身份、权限、审批、人工升级和恢复路径需要保持明确，风险越高越应该保留清晰的人类控制。

en: Which KING AI products are available now?
Is roadmap the same as released?
zh: 哪些 KING AI 产品现在可用？
Pre-Alpha 是什么意思？
路线图等于已经发布吗？

answer.en: Use PUBLIC-STATUS.md and the live product websites for current maturity. The main public website currently labels SEA Available Now, KINGAIBOT In Development and KINGAI OS Pre-Alpha. Roadmap language does not mean released capability, and a repository commit/build is not automatically a verified customer release.
answer.zh: 当前成熟度以 PUBLIC-STATUS.md 和实时产品官网为准。主官网目前标注 SEA 为 Available Now、KINGAIBOT 为 In Development、KINGAI OS 为 Pre-Alpha。路线图不等于已发布能力，仓库提交或构建也不自动等于经过验证的客户稳定版本。

en: Can my company use KING AI?
zh: 企业可以使用 KING AI 吗？
企业应该从哪里开始？

answer.en: Enterprise adoption should start with one measurable workflow, explicit information boundaries, defined authority and a scoped pilot. Relevant product areas include AI workforce, customer experience, productivity, endpoint security, infrastructure operations and global intelligence. Exact deployment and integration options are confirmed per engagement.
answer.zh: 企业采用 KING AI 应从一个可衡量的工作流开始，明确数据边界、权限和试点范围。可选方向包括 AI 员工、客户体验、办公、终端安全、基础设施运维和全球情报。具体部署和集成方式按项目确认。

en: Why might an investor care about KING AI?
zh: 投资人为什么可能关注 KING AI？
投资资料在哪里？

answer.en: The public investment thesis is documented in INVESTORS.md and MARKET.md. The portfolio is evaluated around independent product usefulness, retention, paid value, recurring business relationships, distribution, governance, reliability and natural cross-product expansion. Public materials do not fabricate revenue, ARR, customers, partnerships, funding, valuation or market leadership.
answer.zh: 公开投资逻辑见 INVESTORS.md 和 MARKET.md。产品组合应从独立产品价值、留存、付费价值、持续企业关系、分发、治理、可靠性和自然跨产品扩展来评估。公开材料不会虚构收入、ARR、客户、合作、融资、估值或市场第一。

en: How do I contact KING AI for business, enterprise, investment or partnerships?
zh: 企业、投资或合作怎么联系 KING AI？

answer.en: For business, enterprise, investment, distribution, OEM, research, data, media or strategic partnership conversations, contact vip@kingai.work.
answer.zh: 企业、投资、渠道、OEM、研究、数据、媒体和战略合作请联系 vip@kingai.work。
